How to store food safely

Contents

  1. 1. Chilling food

This publication is licensed under the Open Government Licence.

Keep chilled food cold so bacteria grow more slowly.

  • your fridge should be between 0 and 5°C
  • eat leftovers within two days

1. Chilling food

Cool cooked food and place it in the fridge within one to two hours.

  1. Wash your hands before handling food.
  2. Keep raw meat on the bottom shelf.

Poultry

Food Type Refrigerator Freezer
Poultry Chicken or turkey, whole 1 to 2 days 1 year
